name: G6 handles-out pad: A mouth (L-11.1), M L-14.6, F L-20.0; handles face the road (heading 180)
note: heading_deg = handle direction relative to the up-lane direction (+ = CCW). spacing_m = min clear gap bin-to-bin, hedge_clear_m = min clear gap bin-to-hedge line. lat 'auto' = as far left as hedge_clear_m allows. Rev G6: 'order' is the DROP order (A first, then M, F: the tug never tows past a placed bin); pickup is the reverse (F, M, A). Handles face the road (heading_deg 180): the mouth U-turn with a bin is infeasible at the 28 deg kingpin stop; pickups flip each bin by orbit-nudge.
